label: rem:hadron-fibre-embedding-remark
title: Why hadrons embed in the geometric fibre
html:
Abstract hadrons encode topological data algebraically. To represent a physical particle, this data must embed into the geometric fibre of the knot bundle over spacetime; a fibre-compatible hadron embedding is that embedding.

The fibre-confinement condition is enforced by a finite Möbius energy bound, preventing the knot complement from developing cusps that reach the fibre boundary. The integrability condition ensures the algebraic structure admits a strict geometric realization.
